title: Vampyre Troubles: Autarkic Lord Sfarosh
summary: The questioning of Autarkic Lord Sfarosh ends with a fight against him and three shadow allies.
overview: The questioning of Autarkic Lord Sfarosh ends with a fight against him and three shadow allies.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Allow the ritual dialogue to progress through the assembled spellcasters; the hostile encounter begins at its conclusion.
Sfarosh’s combat form appears with three shadow creatures. Have tanks ready for the simultaneous arrival.
The hostile Sfarosh immediately attacks the character recorded by the ritual. Complete the fight before his scripted cleanup, about twelve minutes after spawning.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
